T1.reason: A continuous rounded shell encloses the body and boxy covers hide the limb servos, but small dark hardware slots and exposed axle shafts still show through gaps at the hips and knees.

T2.reason: Cream shell and dark charcoal mechanism are applied consistently by role, with a single saturated orange accent placed deliberately on the feet.

T3.reason: Most rotation axes are marked by matching dark round disc caps, but the hip joints expose thin bare shafts between disc and body, so not every axis reads as a finished feature.

T4.reason: The body is a rounded box with moderate radii, but the upper-leg segments are sharp-edged rectangular blocks, so the limbs still read as boxes and plates rather than soft merged forms.

T5.reason: A dark oval slot on the front end gives a face element and a front, but it is small and generic and gives little character.

T6.reason: A compact body sits on legs whose shanks taper to distinct orange ball feet, giving a balanced, intentional four-legged stance.

T7.reason: Clean gradient backdrop, soft contact shadows and antialiased edges from a good three-quarter angle, but the view is elevated rather than low and the CAD-style shading lacks studio material polish.
